verdict.rationale: ADK's Workflow Runtime supports fan-out/fan-in, loops, dynamic nodes and retry. Developers can use these to process many items in parallel or in sequence, but bulk processing is only an implied pattern they must build themselves. There is no dedicated batch feature. Missing for 10: a first-class batch/bulk API or CLI command, docs or examples showing bulk processing across many items, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
